observations: Three retail boxes for Polystar electric kettles are stacked.
The boxes identify the model as PVKL-903.
The boxes state '1.8L STAINLESS STEEL ELECTRIC KETTLE'.
The actual kettles are not visible outside of their packaging.
The boxes appear to be in new condition, though one has some plastic wrap on top.

claims.evidence: The kettle is not visible; the box does not explicitly state 'cordless' on the front face shown.
The kettle is inside the box; the lid mechanism cannot be seen.
This feature is not listed on the visible part of the packaging.
The kettle is not powered on or visible.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged item.
risks.proof: A photo of the kettle out of the box next to the packaging.

risks.risk: The heating element may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle plugged in and successfully boiling water.

risks.risk: The automatic shut-off or boil-dry protection may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle clicking off automatically once the water reaches a boil.

proof_requests: Photo of the kettle outside the box to confirm condition and contents.
Video of the kettle boiling water and automatically switching off.
Photo of the base and the bottom of the kettle to confirm it is cordless.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the retail packaging, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case functional state of that specific model.
